basics.name: Watcharapong Wongkaew
basics.label: Civil Engineering Researcher · Transportation & Urban Mobility
basics.summary: Master's student in the Department of Civil Engineering, The University of Tokyo, working on the Generative Urban Foundation Model in Sekimoto Lab (IIS, CSIS), which generates realistic human-mobility trajectories across cities worldwide from real data. Three years of research experience spanning transportation science, travel behavior, geography, and artificial intelligence.

projects.name: Generative Urban Foundation Model
projects.summary: Sekimoto Lab (IIS, CSIS), The University of Tokyo — generating realistic human-mobility trajectories across global cities from real data with a decoder-only transformer; exploring world models and diffusion methods.

projects.name: Pseudo-PFLOW: Synthetic Mobility Simulation
projects.summary: Nationwide agent-based simulation of business vehicles generating 4.5M daily trips for 1.5M+ truck and taxi agents across 106 zones, with calibration and cross-verification against source statistics.

projects.name: AI for Railway Infrastructure (Book Chapter)
projects.summary: Author of a chapter in Elsevier's “Artificial Intelligence for Railway Infrastructure” on railway-track management under extreme events using machine learning — a case study in Thailand's tropical-climate regions.

projects.name: Land Use & Public-Transport Ridership Analysis
